summary: Fairbanks police recorded two arrests on Tuesday: a felony assault arrest on Twelfth Avenue and a theft and trespass arrest on South Cushman Street. A Fairbanks case opened last week with no charge against it now carries a drink-driving count. Neither the Alaska State Troopers dispatch nor the Fairbanks police bulletin had reported anything in the Fairbanks area for Wednesday at the time of reading. The 37 Fairbanks filings counted below are the weekly charges report's own count for its window of Nov. 18 to Nov. 24; that report lists no cases at the Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction courts for the week.

entries.title: Felony assault arrest: Jeremiah Fagan Alexander
body: Jeremiah Fagan Alexander, 35, was arrested on a charge of assault in the third degree - causing another person to fear injury with a weapon - a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. 500 block of Twelfth Avenue, Fairbanks, Nov. 24 at 1:41 a.m.; Fairbanks Police.
The Fairbanks court filed one count the same day. The charge stands on a complaint rather than an indictment, and the court does not record it as domestic violence related.

Police case 26003560; court case 4FA-26-02340CR, before Judge Earl A. Peterson. Arraignment was held Nov. 24 and counsel was appointed from the bench. Preliminary hearings are set for Dec. 3 and Dec. 14.

entries.title: Theft and trespass arrest: Oliver L Delp
body: Oliver L Delp, 36, was arrested on charges of theft in the fourth degree - taking property worth less than $250 - and criminal trespass in the second degree - entering or remaining on premises unlawfully. Both are recorded by police as misdemeanors. 1500 block of South Cushman Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 24 at 3:54 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Police case 26003568. The Alaska Court System case record holds no 2026 case in this name, so no charge class and no court date are stated here.

entries.title: DUI charge: Felipe Gomez Soto
body: Felipe Gomez Soto is charged with driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, a Class A misdemeanor. Fairbanks, offense date Nov. 20.

The charge was brought by the prosecutor on an Information rather than on a police complaint, and the court does not record the count as domestic violence related. The case was opened on Nov. 21 with no charge recorded against it, and the charge has been entered since.
Case 4FA-26-02320CR, before Judge Ben A. Seekins. Arraignment is set for Nov. 27 at 8:30 a.m.
